[SWS_CORE_02001]
⌊
DRAFT
g
StringView
class
⌈
The namespace
ara::core
shall provide a class
StringView
:
class StringView { ... };
⌋
(RS_AP_00130)
All members of this class and supporting constructs (such as global relational opera-
tors) shall behave identical to those of header
<string_view>
from [9] section 24.4.
All supporting symbols shall be contained within namespace
ara::core
.
8.1.13 String data types
This section describes the
ara::core::String
type and its complement
ara::-
core::BasicString
which both represent sequences of characters.
These types are closely modeled on
std::string
and
std::basic_string
re-
spectively from [4, the C++14 standard], with a number of additions coming from [9,
the C++17 standard].
